non_parameter_annotation_exception: top-level note may differ; execution settings and complete provenance remain identical
identity_requirements: same source-code hash, model request/response aliases and actual fingerprint, prepared and observed image identities, all base resource and execution parameters
Only two declared parameter paths may differ across corrected variants; do not change output cap or other settings in this comparison
effective config hashes must match their own recorded effective configs

excluded_original_environment.reason: Unchanged public PyVista baseline had missing tqdm/meshio; retain original bytes and charges for audit only, never use its outcomes in corrected setting selection.

legal_candidate_definition.submission: A retained legal candidate counts as submittable only when the stage selected patch equals a legal history candidate.
legal_candidate_definition.inherited_vs_new: Inherited legal prefix candidates remain valid; report new non-prefix origin and novel generation separately, never require a new origin merely to declare retained-candidate flow usable.

prefix_completion: Scheduled localisation and both configured candidate attempts complete without prefix_stop/error, environment error or budget overrun; alternatively a legal public-pass candidate leads to the shared A/C/D stop. Shared public pass is not a missing eligible pair.
usable_flow_definition: The designated case has a complete prefix or legal public-pass shared stop.
For an eligible failure, fixed and interactive stages exist, each has at least one actual recorded request, normal bounded completion and a retained legal submitted candidate.

Use the complete saved prefix_snapshot and observable first-request inherited token/model/tool budgets, matching ceilings/task identities; do not reconstruct an unrecorded full initial branch snapshot.
The standalone B stage likewise exists and can submit a legal candidate.
No missing stage/case, recorded environment/identity/lifecycle error, failed unknown-usage request or resource overrun counts as completed flow.

normal_bounded_termination.interpretation: Reaching six calls while retaining a legal candidate is recorded as a normal limit stop, not automatically an unusable flow or proof of model inability. No candidate, missing work, environment errors and overruns are separately reported.

resource_setting_selection.trigger: Use only actual truncation/resource-refusal evidence under the original protocol, never official solved labels.
resource_setting_selection.comparison: Compare complete corrected settings on the same three IDs.
resource_setting_selection.tie: Keep the baseline resource setting; do not choose ten calls just because six was reached.

prefix_setting_selection_order: Exclude a setting if a designated prefix cannot complete or preserve minimum continuation when still running; exempt legal public-pass shared stops.
Maximise usable-flow case count, including usable standalone B.
Maximise prefix-stage legal-candidate case coverage (each case counted once).
extractor_outputs: Operational evidence only: no official verdicts, threshold fitting, or automatic setting selection.
unknowns: Public-test classification may not identify every dependency issue; acceptance of the corrected public environment is a separate prerequisite.
These three cases measure operational feasibility, not method superiority or full-dev calibration.
